description: Retrospective. apps/api (Hono) and apps/web (React 19 + Vite), with packages/shared holding the API contract and packages/tsconfig and packages/eslint-config holding the strict TypeScript base and flat ESLint config. Node 22, ESM throughout, Docker Compose for local Postgres on port 5435.
title: Scaffold the pnpm and Turborepo monorepo
